name: print-social-black-stand-banner-mockup-with-gradient-health-poster
title: Health Banner on a Black Display Stand
whatItIs: A pale page with a Banner Design pill and a black display stand on a round base holding a poster with a blue to lilac gradient header, a petal-person logo, a headline 'Health Made Smarter', a short line and a photo of four people giving thumbs up.
whatItMeans: A simple gradient header and a friendly group photo make a clear trust-building poster, and the stand shows it in use.
techniques: Gradient header for the headline area
Group photo bleeding to the bottom of the poster
Black stand with a round base
Plain pale page around the mockup

vocabulary.definition: A floor stand that holds a poster upright.
The upper area of a poster filled with a colour blend.
A photo of several people used to convey community.
